title: P0.81: Post-consultation UI stall and security handoff learning
description: Prevent post-result development packet refresh from running on the UI thread and preserve a structured active incident when ChatGPT returns browser_security_verification after dispatch.
reason: Live runtime audit on 2026-06-01 showed a 38842ms UI event loop stall after a ChatGPT attempt. Stack trace: _apply_task_result -> _refresh_development_packet -> build_codex_packet -> execution_dossier_repository.list_recent(limit=120) -> JSON load. The same run also blocked ChatGPT with browser_security_verification and no live target window.
next_action: Live Windows proof: run a ChatGPT consultation from the desktop shortcut. The terminal state may still be blocked_by_security_verification, but the UI must not stall on post-result packet refresh and follow-up messages like 'hazlo tu' or 'muestrame la ventana' must use the active incident frame.
resume_hint: P0.81 adds _schedule_idle_dev_packet_refresh(), uses it from _apply_task_result/_apply_task_failure/buildDevelopmentPacket, and creates an ActiveIncidentFrame for browser_security_verification returned by the external consultation result path.
